rubric.note: manual, judge stage; not verifiable in review

findings.issue: Browser colour checks read getComputedStyle of the <g data-part> group, not of the <path> that is actually painted. A colour set on the path overrides the group and goes unnoticed by every functional test; only the macOS-only visual snapshot catches it, so CI (Linux) would not.
findings.evidence: Mutant in a scratch copy: added stroke="#00ff00" on the rank <path> and fill on the suit <path>. Unit tests and e2e/cards.spec.ts (chromium) all passed; e2e/cards.visual.spec.ts failed on faces-two-colour.
findings.fix: In faceColours, read the computed stroke/fill from face.querySelector('[data-part="rank"] path') and '[data-part="suit"] path' (inherited values equal the group's in a correct implementation), or assert both group and path. This is a locked test, so the orchestrator decides whether to unlock it.

findings.issue: The 'decoded TLH logo' test proves the href data URL decodes to 512x512 (in a separate Image probe) and that the <image> box is at least 48x48, but not that the logo is painted. opacity=0 or visibility=hidden on the <image> passes in CI; only the macOS visual snapshot catches it. This meets SPEC-06 as written; the gap is for CI.
findings.evidence: Mutant: opacity={0} on the logo <image>. e2e/cards.spec.ts passed 5/5 (chromium); the visual spec failed.
findings.fix: Optional: also assert getComputedStyle(image).opacity === '1' and visibility === 'visible', or sample the centre pixel of an element screenshot of the back and check it is not pure #000000. Locked test, so the orchestrator decides.

findings.issue: 'glyphs fit the card' checks the hand-written width fields, not the path geometry, and RANK_GLYPHS[].width is never read by the component. The real fit check is the e2e bounding-box/visual tests.
findings.evidence: RANK_GLYPHS widths appear only in this test; PlayingCard.tsx uses only symbol.width (suit).
findings.fix: Accept as is (the spec requires the field), or drop this test and rely on SPEC-02.

findings.issue: PlayingCard calls formatCard(card) and then cardLabel(card), which calls formatCard again. This is harmless redundancy.
findings.fix: Leave as is; cardLabel must validate on its own per SPEC-08.

summary: All 13 SPEC items are implemented as specified. Visual check of gallery.png: all 52 faces have the right rank, suit and colour in both modes, ten shows as '10', 6 and 9 are clearly different, Q has a visible tail, and the back shows the logo inside a red frame. The two `as` casts in PlayingCard (RankLabel, SuitName) are safe because formatCard validates first. They are needed only because of noUncheckedIndexedAccess. The AC#2 measurement is genuine: DPR is pinned to 1 and asserted, the viewport is asserted to be 1280x720, and each rank/suit group is measured with both boundingBox and getBBox*CTM.d. Scaling the glyph to 0.8 or 0.5 kills the test. The visual skip applies at file level to cards.visual.spec.ts only, so cards.spec.ts runs in CI. The gallery is not in the app bundle (checked with a build in a scratch copy). Mutants killed: glyph scaled down x2, four-colour swap, context default, prop override ignored, label typo, validation removed. Survivors: a path-level colour override and a hidden logo, both caught only by the macOS visual snapshots (MINOR). No BLOCKER or MAJOR findings.
